messages:
Alex Chen: RFC review sync tomorrow 10–11am PT. Need to lock who presents which RFC and the agenda order. RFC link: https://redwood.ai/rfcs/381
Maria Diaz: I can present RFC-381 (KV cache API). Prefer slot 10:05. Pre-read posted in doc, comments open until EOD today.
Sahil Gupta: I can review live. Quick note — I'll only be available until 10:30 then back at 11:15. Happy to take reviewer slot early.
Jenn Park: Can we prioritize the customer-impacting ones first? Suggested order: infra perf, cache API, rollout policy.
Lee Wong: +1 Jenn. Also propose authors give 5m recap, 10m Q&A. If we have >1 RFC from an author, combine.
Maria Diaz: That works. My pre-read includes a short perf table: ```
P50 latency: 18ms
P95 latency: 45ms
CPU draw: -8%
```
Alex Chen: @Sahil noted availability. @Olivia can you confirm reviewer coverage for rollout policy?
Olivia Brooks: I can take rollout policy review and do follow-up async comments by EOD. Not in sync tomorrow.
DevBot: Calendar invite created for "RFC review sync" 2026-03-18 10:00 PT. Attendees: alex.chen, maria, sahil, jenn, lee, olivia.
Sahil Gupta: If Olivia's async, let's move rollout policy to last on agenda and have Maria then Lee first.
Jenn Park: Agenda draft:
1) Quick ops updates (2m)
2) KV cache API — Maria (10m + 5m Q&A)
3) Runtime perf RFC — Lee (8m + 7m Q&A)
4) Rollout policy — async review summary (5m)
Please add any blockers now. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Thanks all — I'll pin the agenda and close pre-read comments at 17:00 PT today. If you can't make live, leave comments in doc or flag @alex.chen for quick sync.
Maria Diaz: noted, will post final slide at noon. :raised_hands:
Lee Wong: I'll prep perf graphs and link to benchmark notebook: https://internal/redwood/bench/kv-cache
Olivia Brooks: I'll summarize async comments in a short note during the sync so action items are clear.
Alex Chen: Great — see you tomorrow. :rocket:
